events.context: Detailed explanation of spinous layer (有棘层) structure, origin of name from spiny bridge-like connections (桥粒), mechanical strength provided to epidermis
Cell state in spinous layer: cells originate from basal layer, migrate upward, transition from proliferative to terminally differentiating cells synthesizing keratin
Key functions of spinous layer: structural support via bridge granules, immune defense by Langerhans cells, nutrient exchange, differentiation stage for keratinization

Common skin problems in spinous layer: psoriasis (accelerated proliferation), eczema (edema and blisters), viral infections (HPV warts, herpes zoster), pemphigus (autoimmune bridge granule destruction)
Summary of spinous layer as intermediate reinforcement layer in epidermal 'brick wall', providing mechanical strength, immune surveillance, keratinization initiation
User asks '颗粒层是干嘛的呢' (What does the granular layer do?)
System begins detailed explanation of granular layer (颗粒层) as key quality control and waterproof layer
Granular layer position above spinous layer, below stratum corneum; appearance with keratohyalin granules; thickness varies by skin area

Core functions: produces filaggrin for natural moisturizing factor (NMF), secretes lamellar bodies for lipid waterproof barrier, initiates keratinization and programmed cell death, minor UV reflection
Granular layer metaphor as 'waterproof and adhesive factory' producing NMF precursors and lipid 'cement' for stratum corneum
Skin problems related to granular layer: atopic dermatitis (filaggrin mutations), psoriasis (thinning), dry skin, ichthyosis
Summary of granular layer as core hub for moisturizing, waterproofing, and cell transformation
